summary.intent: Coordinate parallel agent tracks (B–E) in a worktree-based effort on the frontend-design evaluation/navigator plugin work, merging each track's results into the main branch and running checks.
summary.outcome: Merged tracks C, D and E into the main branch (b2ae64e6) with a log-only conflict resolved, and `just marketplace-sync` and `just check` both exit 0. Track B (gate hygiene) is still running; the final steps (path rewrite, Codex re-sync, version bumps, full checks) are pending.

repo: `just check` and `just marketplace-sync` are the validation and sync commands; marketplace-sync regenerates dist/codex and must be re-run after merges.
docs/evaluations/frontend-design/IMPLEMENTATION-LOG.md is appended to by every track, so merges conflict there; the conflict is resolved by keeping both sides (via /tmp/claude-501/keepboth.py).

plan@1 schema requires only id, title, files, steps (free-string array) and commit_message per task, with additionalProperties false; it never required code, only two description strings mention 'exact code'.
ADR conventions (decision-records.md): change status and links rather than rewriting an old ADR's body. ADR 014 partially supersedes ADR 009's every-task-code requirement.
Planner and challenger agents live in plugins/navigator/agents/planner.md and challenger.md, with a skill at plugins/navigator/skills/plan/SKILL.md and a Codex counterpart.
A relative `shared/schemas` path does not resolve from a user's project directory, so planners invent forbidden task keys unless the schema path is named explicitly in the prompt.
workflow: The subagent hand-back was treated as a report, not user authority; the merge was an ordinary integration action within this session.
Measurement runs from a temp project without the schemas directory were discarded because they produced invalid output, so fixtures must include or reference the schema path.
The 43% plan-size reduction rests on one run each on one small fixture and is weak evidence.

friction: Repeated log-file merge conflicts across tracks required a helper script to resolve.
The relative `shared/schemas` path failed to resolve from the temp project, which invalidated the first pair of measurement runs.
The planner prompt grew (about 1,024 to 1,260 words) while its output shrank.
open_items: Track B (gate hygiene) still needs to be merged.
Apply the `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` path rewrite, re-sync Codex, do the version bumps and run the full checks.
The user should review ADR 014's partial supersession of ADR 009.
Unverified: whether implementers do better or worse with outcome-level plans, how the challenger behaves on either plan shape, weaker implementer models, amend mode and Codex behavior.
A plan@2 with explicit outcome, signature and test fields is deferred.
The two stale 'exact code' description strings in plan@1 are left unedited per ADR 004.
The relative `shared/schemas` path resolution problem for user projects remains unfixed.
The judgment on when the planner should include code may err toward too little or too much.
